'''Drelliad boots''' were a type of boot considered medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. The boots were [[brown]] in color.
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Voidhound|Ace]] and a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Republic trooper]] was given a pair of boots of this make by the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Yael]] whilst in [[Fort Garnik]] refugee camp on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Yael gave it to them as thanks for bringing her medicine stolen from her by members of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Drelliad boots first appeared as an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] in the Massively multiplayer online roleplaying game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' published by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The item is available as a reward to characters of the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] or [[Republic trooper|Trooper]] class for the completion of a quest on their starting [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The item can only be acquired in this way and so other classes can only obtain it through trading and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] players currently cannot obtain it. The boot's relation to [[Drelliad village]], if any, is unknown.
